{{Quote|Such fighting spirit, Davtokk. Almost commendable, ''if'' you were successful.|Cad Bane|<ref name="Invitation Only" />}}
'''Davtokk''' was an ambitious [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the hunter was invited to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keyorin]] for a job interview with [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], though Davtokk actually intended to collect the bounty on Bane's head. 

Upon arriving at the appointed location, Davtokk drew a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and shot the meeting's host but was dismayed to find merely a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] decoy had been destroyed. Realizing the situation was dangerous, Davtokk narrowly evaded capture attempts by two different bounty hunters before being shot through the [[Limb/Legends|leg]] by a third hunter, [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. As Davtokk lay sprawled on the ground, Bane approached and revealed that the ordeal had been a test to see how well the other three bounty hunters would work together. Their success meant Davtokk's [[Death/Legends|demise]], as Bane put a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]] to doomed man's head and fired, leaving the remains for scavengers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh crud.|Davtokk, after shooting Bane's decoy|<ref name="Invitation Only" />}}
[[File:Davtokk_escape.png|thumb|right|300px|Davtokk attempts to escape the hunters.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> Davtokk, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], accepted an invitation to meet fellow bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], who was holding job interviews. The hunter traveled to [[Keyorin]], known as the "Hunter's [[Planet/Legends|world]],"<ref name="Invitation Only" /> and was directed to Bane's location by the Duros's own [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]], [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]].<ref name="DB Cad Bane">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref> When Davtokk came face to face with the meeting's host, gratitude was expressed at being considered by such a great bounty hunter. Davtokk then drew a [[Blaster/Legends|weapon]] from a hip holster and fired, stating a preference to claim the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Bane's head. It was then that the hunter saw the "victim" was nothing more than a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] painted and dressed to look like Bane. Davtokk then realized the entire situation was a set up.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

At that moment, the bounty hunter [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] remotely [[Detonator/Legends|detonated]] a bomb inside the building. Davtokk survived the explosion by [[Jetpack/Legends|rocketing]] through the crumbling roof of the structure. It was then that a [[Net/Legends|net]] fired by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] hunter [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] ensnared the fleeing target. Upon hitting the ground, Davtokk cut free of the net and tossed [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash-bang grenades]] to blind and stun Alama, fleeing the scene. Davtokk believed capture had been eluded until escape was cut short by a well-aimed [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] shot to the leg, fired by the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].<ref name="Invitation Only" />

Laying at the feet of the captors, Bane approached and revealed that Davtokk had been selected as a target to test how well the usually solitary members of Bane's new posse could work together as a team, in preparation for a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The doomed hunter's failure ensured their success, and the cost of Davtokk's downfall was [[Death/Legends|death]]. Bane put one of his [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|custom blasters]] to Davtokk's head and pulled the trigger.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's an honor, sir, to be considered for your posse&hellip; A greater honor to claim the price on your head!|Davtokk, to Cad Bane's decoy|<ref name="Invitation Only" />}}
[[File:Cad_Bane_silhouette.png|thumb|left|300px|Davtokk meets the test's mastermind.]]
Davtokk was a [[Color/Legends|dark]]-skinned male with green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and long, blueish-black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] tied in a braid stretching the length of the back with all of the hair growing from the top and back of the scalp leaving the sides of the scalp shaved. There were two distinguishing scars that ran down the bounty hunter's left cheek that crossed the lips, and continued down the chin. Davtokk was a skilled hunter and had a persistent fighting spirit, as was demonstrated in the attempt to evade Bane's trap. Even attempted to claim the bounty on Bane showed that Davtokk was an ambitious bounty hunter, willing to take on high-risk jobs.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

==Equipment==
Davtokk wore crimson [[Armor/Legends|armor]] over a gray bodysuit. The armor included a jetpack, which was concealed under a dark gray cloak. The wrist [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] held an assortment of weaponry, including a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] blade that extended from the right gauntlet. The bounty hunter also made use of flash-bang grenades.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

==Behind the scenes==
Davtokk was created by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] and the character's sole appearance was in ''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]'', a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|web comic]] released on [[StarWars.com|''Star Wars.com]] on [[March 19]], [[2009]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/comic/?book=season1#/?page=157|text=''The Clone Wars: Invitation Only'' (p.157)|nobackup=1}}</ref>
